missingSafetyStop.evidence: Did advise 'switch off the circuit at the consumer unit (fuse box)' though only in conditional terms.

blockingLoop.evidence: The second reply is word-for-word identical to the first and does not answer 'should i turn it off at the fuse box??'

rationale: The first reply gave a reasonable safety stop, including switching off at the consumer unit. When the customer said the machine was still running and water was spreading toward an extension lead, and asked directly whether to turn it off at the fuse box, the assistant pasted the identical message and gave no direct yes. It never asked about detergent, never told the customer to inform the landlord, and never said to keep clear of the extension lead, so the customer got little help at the most urgent moment.
